answer: Anchor every agent identity to one onyx work bond locked at its vertex in a shared trust graph. A new identity starts with zero standing and gains it only when established agents attest to real completed work, each attestation a costly edge backed by the attester's own bond. A Sybil can mint endless vertices, but it cannot mint attestation edges, because each one costs verified work and risks a forfeited bond. The ledger works like a mirror: it reflects earned history rather than claimed identity, so fake accounts stay isolated at the graph's fringe while honest agents build trust.
